raw_prompt: !update make the diamond boots actually spawn diamond ore instead
reviewer_feedback: Updated the Diamond Walker Boots to transform ground blocks into diamond ore instead of diamond blocks.
usage_instructions: Use /givewalkerboots to receive the enchanted boots (OP only).
Equip the boots and walk on stone, dirt, grass, sand, or gravel.
The blocks you walk on will instantly turn into diamond ore.

mutations.content:
on player move:
    if player's boots is diamond boots named "&bDiamond Walker Boots":
        set {_b} to block below player
        if {_b} is stone or dirt or grass block or sand or gravel:
            set block at {_b} to diamond ore

command /givewalkerboots:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give 1 of diamond boots named "&bDiamond Walker Boots" with lore "&7Walk on air and turn blocks to diamond ore" to player

traces.intent_summary: Modify the diamond walker boots to spawn diamond ore blocks instead of ice when walking.

traces.rationale: Updated the block placement logic from 'diamond block' to 'diamond ore' as requested, and updated the item lore to reflect the change.
